description: Item 3 (user 2026-11-06: same as the workbench, just set this range): the Troll Hub carries a copy of the workbench's PlayerBase effect area with NoSpawnRadius (50 m), so no wild creature spawns near it. The hub stands 25 m ahead of the player; a point 45 m behind it (inside 50 m) is inside the base area, a point 70 m behind it is outside.
